definitions.gloss: leaving farmland fallow; resting agricultural land
definitions.explanation: The practice of leaving farmland uncultivated for a period to restore soil fertility, or the state of farmland being unused. Also refers to government-mandated reduction of rice production.

examples.japanese: {休耕|きゅうこう}{地|ち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}ませる→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧{休耕|きゅうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The land will lie fallow for one year to rest the soil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}り→減る：01985_heru⟧、{休耕|きゅうこう}{田|でん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: As the population ages and farmers decrease, fallow rice paddies have become conspicuous.

notes: Composed of {休|きゅう} (rest) + {耕|こう} (cultivate, plow). An agricultural term. Common collocations: {休耕|きゅうこう}{地|ち} (fallow land), {休耕|きゅうこう}{田|でん} (fallow rice paddy), {休耕|きゅうこう}⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ (fallow paddy field). In Japan, {休耕|きゅうこう}{田|でん} became widespread after the government's {減反|げんたん}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (rice acreage reduction policy) starting in 1970 to combat rice overproduction. Rural depopulation and aging farmers have further increased {休耕|きゅうこう}{地|ち}. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧ (express train).
